name: Blind Pick, No Labels
why_it_works: A blind test removes the brand, so the result feels earned instead of claimed. Viewers instinctively pick a side before the reveal and stay to see if they were right, and people who guessed wrong comment to argue.

hook.pattern: Show two unlabeled options and ask the viewer to pick before strangers do.
examples: Option A or B? Pick before you scroll.
We took the labels off. Strangers picked. You pick too.
Two {{product}}s, no names. Only one is ours.

variables.name: option_b
variables.description: The other option, described generically, never a named brand

variables.name: result
variables.description: The real tally from the test

variables.name: offer
variables.example: Come take the blind test, free sample this weekend

beats.voiceover: A or B. Pick before you scroll.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of two identical unmarked {{product}} samples labeled only A and B on a wooden counter, clean even light, centered symmetrical framing, slight shallow depth of field

beats.voiceover: We asked people on the street. No labels, no hints.

visual.prompt: Real photo from your actual blind test: a participant who signed a release trying sample A then sample B, thoughtful expression, natural daylight, no logos visible
Vertical photo of a hand lifting a card under sample B to reveal the {{brand}} logo, warm spotlight on B, sample A slightly out of focus

craft.notes: Ask the viewer to commit in the first second so they have a stake. Hold the tally before the reveal so the number builds suspense. For musicians, swap cups for two audio clips: rough demo vs final mix, both your own.

do_not: Rig or stage the result; run a real test and report the real count, even if it is close
Name or show a real competitor's brand as option A
Use people on camera without their signed release
